propositions: Bridge orchestration must be implemented as a runner-neutral packaged Python core exposed through three public surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) and available from all supported install paths (pip, Homebrew wheel-backed, MCP Registry/uvx).

The packaged runner accepts five profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) that map to corresponding legacy rebar commands while preserving existing MODE environment variable compatibility.

Provider workflows must invoke the installed rebar bridge run entrypoint rather than repository-local scripts; GitHub/Jenkins/GitLab callers retain only provider-native operations and delegate orchestration to the installed CLI.

All legacy direct reconcile callers retain published benign results (3/4/75); the new provider runner translates benign legacy results to canonical 0 while preserving operational 1 and invalid-invocation 2.
Every successful non-paused pass invokes strict delivery with run id, bot identity, and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always; delivery failure returns exit code 1 with diagnostics.
Provider wrappers must be schema-validated (GitLab Draft-07 with verified provenance) and embedded shell must pass ShellCheck 0.11.0 pinned linting; missing or mismatched tooling fails validation.
